image_description: A side-profile view of a bison standing on a grassy, dirt-covered slope. The bison is facing right, showing its massive shoulder hump, shaggy dark brown fur on the forequarters, and a large head with a visible horn. The hindquarters are partially visible but cut off by the frame edge. The background consists of green vegetation and trees.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile, appearing large and broad relative to the body. One horn is clearly visible, appearing short and curved. The other horn is occluded by the angle but the visible one matches the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct beard of long, dark hair is visible hanging from the chin and throat area.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, consistent with the description.
No prominent ears are sticking out; the ear region is covered by the thick fur of the head, consistent with 'hidden in fur'.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shoulder hump is very prominent and high, creating the characteristic massive silhouette of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur texture is visibly shaggy and dark brown, particularly dense around the shoulders and neck.
The hindquarters are largely cut off by the right edge of the image frame, making it impossible to fully assess the fur density compared to the forequarters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible horn is relatively small compared to the massive bulk of the head and body.
The legs are cut off at the bottom of the frame; hooves are not visible.
The rear of the animal is cut off by the frame; the tail is not visible.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the species classification and rule out hybrid or misidentified bovids.
To verify the structural integrity of the visible limbs and shoulder connection, ensuring no melting or fusion artifacts.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the fur or unnatural blending between the animal and the background vegetation.
To check for edge bleeding or halo effects along the complex fur boundary against the busy background.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency (shaggy vs. smooth patches)
Edge definition between bison fur and background foliage
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the bison's fur and the background. AI generators often struggle with fine hair details against complex backgrounds, leading to 'haloing' or smudging. Verify if the horn looks physically attached and has realistic texture, or if it appears plastic/painted. Check if the visible front leg connects naturally to the body without anatomical distortion.
